request.style: English, male narrative voice, solo, acoustic guitar, fiddle, upright bass, drum kit, pedal steel, somber and urgent, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I came to bring fire on the earth
And how I wish it were already kindled
But I have a baptism to undergo
And what constraint I am under until it is completed

[Pre-Chorus]
Do you think I came to bring peace on earth
No, I tell you, but division
From now on five in one household will be divided
Three against two and two against three

[Chorus]
Father against son and son against father
Mother against daughter and daughter against mother
Mother-in-law against daughter-in-law
And daughter-in-law against mother-in-law

[Verse]
When you see a cloud rising in the west
You say at once, A storm is coming, and so it happens
And when the south wind blows, you say
It will be scorching hot, and it is

[Pre-Chorus]
Hypocrites, you know how to interpret the face of the earth
And the sky, why then do you not know
How to interpret this present time
And why do you not judge for yourselves what is right

[Chorus]
Father against son and son against father
Mother against daughter and daughter against mother
Mother-in-law against daughter-in-law
And daughter-in-law against mother-in-law

[Bridge]
As you are going with your accuser to the magistrate
Make an effort to settle with him on the way
Or he may drag you off to the judge
And the judge hand you over to the officer

[Outro]
The officer throw you into prison
You will not get out until you have paid the very last penny

[Chorus]
Father against son and son against father
Mother against daughter and daughter against mother
Mother-in-law against daughter-in-law
And daughter-in-law against mother-in-law
